name: Everything Is a Differential Equation
effect: Whatever the prompt is (weekend plans, poems, condolences, cooking, identity), the altered model drops it and launches into a pseudo-mathematical derivation full of LaTeX: differential equations, coefficients of friction, integrating factor
source: Qwen Pharmacopoeia: blind judges told it from the plain model on 40/40 held-out pairs. Passed every check, judged alone.
